Frogs-N-Logs Privacy Policy

Last updated November 3, 2026 · Applies to the web game and the Android, iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows and Linux apps.

The short version

Frogs-N-Logs doesn't collect, store or share any personal information. There are no accounts, no ads, no analytics and no tracking.

What the game saves

Your settings (difficulty, volume, graphics, key bindings), best scores, shop upgrades and achievements are saved only on your own device (in your browser's storage on the web, or in the app's own storage). They're never sent anywhere. Uninstalling the app or clearing your browser's site data deletes them.

Internet use

The web version is downloaded from GitHub Pages, which, like any website host, may keep standard server logs (such as IP addresses) for security. See GitHub's privacy statement. The apps don't need the internet to play.

Children

The game is suitable for all ages and collects no information from anyone, including children.

Contact

Questions? Open an issue at github.com/rfcowgillIV/Frogs-N-Logs.
